headline: Clinton order widens a federal disability jobs task force so it also focuses on young people with disabilities.
what_it_does: This order changes an earlier order, Executive Order 13078, which set up a national task force on jobs for adults with disabilities. It expands the task force's role to include a focus on youth with disabilities. No summary was provided, so the exact new duties are not clear from the title alone.

who_it_affects.how: The federal task force on disability employment is told to include their needs in its work.

who_it_affects.group: Members and staff of the National Task Force on Employment of Adults With Disabilities
who_it_affects.how: Their assigned focus grows to cover youth as well as adults.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed October 25, 2000; the exact effective date is not stated in the title.
